d:
Watch both Bollywood Badshahs - Amitabh Bachchan and Shah Rukh Khan shake a leg in this punjabi folk based song from the film 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham', ably supported by Jaya Bachchan and Rani Mukherjee.
Credits:
Song Name - Say Shava Shava
Movie - Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Singer - Sudesh Bhosle, Alka Yagnik, Sunidhi Chauhan, Amitabh Bachchan, Aadesh Shrivastava & Udit Narayan
Lyrics - Sameer Anjaan
Music - Aadesh Shrivastava
Director - Karan Johar
